Title: The name of the software, application, or service.
Type: The category or genre of the product (e.g., Application, Video on demand, Art).
Developer(s): The company or individual(s) responsible for creating the product. Multiple entries are comma-separated.
Publisher(s): The company or individual(s) responsible for distributing the product. Multiple entries are comma-separated.
Regions released/Release date (NTSC)(Jap: Release date for the NTSC region (Japan), marked as 'Unreleased' if not available.
Regions released/Release date (NTSC)(Nor: Release date for the NTSC region (North America), marked as 'Unreleased' if not available.
Regions released/Release date (PAL)(Aust: Release date for the PAL region (Australasia), marked as 'Unreleased' if not available.
Regions released/Release date (PAL)(Euro: Release date for the PAL region (Europe), marked as 'Unreleased' if not available.
var: A combined field indicating the region and release date category (e.g., NTSC Japan, PAL Europe).
value: The release date for the corresponding region specified in 'var', or 'Unreleased' if not available.
